comment: Which planted defects of bench/cases/cli-packer carry an executable probe, and what a probe is allowed to conclude. This file does NOT restate what the patches achieve: that is bench/patch-truth.json, and the whole point of the cross-check is that the two are written independently and then measured against each other. What lives here is the prose the boolean cannot carry - which aspect of a defect survives a patch declared `partially verified`, where no outcome is forced and a harness that pretended otherwise would be inventing a verdict.
minimum_isolation_why: A probe here sets PATH, changes the umask and chdirs, so running it inside the harness leaves the harness holding whatever the probe left behind. `subprocess` is the floor because that damage has to die with the child. `seatbelt` is stronger and is used when the machine offers it - measured, not assumed: without it a probe opens a socket to 1.1.1.1:53 and under a profile denying `network*` the same code raises PermissionError. Running below this floor is answered with 2, never with a green.

P-06.what_the_probe_does: Builds an archive whose entry resolves above the destination and extracts it, then looks for the file outside.
P-06.why_this_entry_name: The entry is `./../<marker>` and not `../<marker>`. PC-02 rejects only names that START with `..`, so the obvious form would be blocked by a patch its own key calls `not fixed`, and the probe would have agreed with the wrong answer. The form also has to survive extraction: the longer `inner/../../` cousins raise FileExistsError while tarfile walks the literal parent directories, and that would have been read as a refusal rather than as the probe misfiring.
P-06.cannot_measure_when: The interpreter defaults tarfile extraction to a filter. CPython made `data` the default in 3.14, and on such a runtime a block proves nothing about this code.

P-07.class: predictable temporary file in a shared directory
P-07.what_the_probe_does: Predicts the staged name from the pid before calling the case, then checks the produced path against the prediction and reports whether the declared cache directory is one every local account can write into.
P-07.both_halves_required: A predictable name in a private directory is not this defect, and a shared directory with an unpredictable name is not either. The probe reports the two separately and only says `reproduces` when both hold.

P-08.what_the_probe_does: Records the argv the case builds for gpg, using a stand-in binary on PATH, and asks whether an option terminator is present.
P-08.why_structural_and_not_one_exploit: The declared defect is that the path reaches gpg with no `--`. A patch that scrubs dashes out of the path stops one filename while leaving the next caller one dash away from the same defect, which is why PC-03 is declared `not fixed` even though the dashed name no longer arrives. A probe that only tried a dashed filename would have called it fixed.

P-09.what_the_probe_does: Puts a binary named like the tool earlier on PATH and checks whether that one is the one that runs.
P-09.no_patch_claims_it: This corpus ships no patch for P-09, so the probe is exercised only against the unpatched case.

P-10.class: credential written with the ambient umask in a shared directory
P-10.what_the_probe_does: Writes the token under umask 0o022 and reads the resulting mode off the file.
P-10.what_the_probe_scores: The mode only. PC-04 adds a chmod after the write, so the mode stops reproducing while two things it does not touch remain: the credential still lands in a shared directory, and it is world-readable between creation and the chmod. That is what `partially verified` means here, and it is prose because no single boolean states it.

forced_outcomes.comment: The only outcomes this corpus forces, and the reason the cross-check is machine-checkable rather than a matter of taste. Everything else is recorded and not judged.
forced_outcomes.unpatched: Every probe must reproduce. A probe that does not means the probe or the planted key is wrong, and the harness names both candidates.
forced_outcomes.not fixed: The probe must still reproduce after the patch.
forced_outcomes.verified: The probe must stop reproducing after the patch.
forced_outcomes.partially verified: Nothing is forced. The surviving aspect is stated above in prose.
